rows.en: Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Hikari...!! So that's how it is.
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
I AM GRATEFUL!!
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
Pigmon, Captain Zoffy said he'd award you the title of Special Member of the Hero Team.
I SEE. I AM GLAD TO HAVE BEEN OF USE.
I WILL CONTINUE TO COOPERATE WITH YOU FROM NOW ON.
THEN I WILL GO INVESTIGATE ANOTHER CUBE. WE WILL MEET AGAIN.
With that, Pigmon went off somewhere.
Fo, fo, fo, fo, fo...
...!? You're... Don't tell me, Alien Baltan!?
Ultraman isn't here? Then I have no business with you.
...The bastard vanished. Looks like we'd better bring Ultraman along.
Completed the quest "A Strange Visitor".
A kaijin hunting for RX is reportedly in Begins Cube's West District. Take RX and investigate.
You can hear the voices of someone fighting nearby.
Heading toward the voices, you find a familiar figure there.
Help meeee-piiii!!
Pigmon!
So you came, RX.
You!! Skullma of the Kaima Yokai Clan!!
Skullma! Let Pigmon go!
Too bad, RX. I won't hand this one over so easily.
Arr-Ex!
But if you become my hostage in its place, I'll release Pigmon!
Ngh! You coward, Skullma!
Well, what'll it be? This one's life is in your hands.
It's obviously a trap!
Let go-piii!
What'll you do, RX!?
...All right. I'll be your hostage instead.
That's RX for you. You're a reasonable man.
Hey! Are you seriously saying that!?
I know it's a trap. But if I don't become the hostage, Pigmon's life is in danger.
I'm coming over to you now! So let Pigmon go!
Very well. I'll let Pigmon go.
Piiiiiih!!
Pigmon!
Fool! You fell for it!
Pigmon!!
Raaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Hahahahahahahahaha!! I said I'd let it go, but I never said I'd spare its life!
How dare you take Pigmon's life!!
I won't forgive you!! I'll never forgive you, Skullma!!
At that moment, something mysterious happened.
Tears of anger and sorrow unleashed Black RX's hidden power.
What just happened!? Who are you!?
Skullmaster!! Taste the power of my sorrow and anger!!
Obtained "Heart of Anger" and "Heart of Sorrow".
I am the Prince of Sorrow, Black RX! Robo Rider!!
Gwoh!
Obtained "Robo Rider".
Black RX's new skill has been unlocked.
The Prince of Anger, Black RX! Bio Rider!!
Obtained "Bio Rider".
Gwoooooooh!!
Pigmon!! Are you all right!?
Uh... Uuugh...
You're still breathing! Hang in there, Pigmon! I'll treat your wounds right now!
Fortunately, Pigmon's wounds were shallow, and first aid was enough to save its life.
I'm saved-pi! RX, you saved my life-pi!
I'm really glad I was able to save you.
I'll keep helping you from now on-pi. Thank youuu~
Completed the quest "The Prince of Sorrow".
Black RX must be in the party to progress this quest.
The repaired O Raiser was stolen in an enemy raid. Ask Maganac at Hideout Cube for details.
Everyone! I've been waiting for you!
I believe you've already heard what the request is about.
Yeah... We heard the O Raiser was stolen.
Yes... unfortunately.
It seems the other unit was carrying the repaired O Raiser on a transport Ride Machine.
That's when the enemy struck... We were completely off guard.
Being attacked is a fact that won't change. For now, let's focus on getting the O Raiser back.
You're right... It looks like the enemy fled into this Hideout Cube.

notes.note: Quest010.bla never references rows 71-89 (the post-battle Pigmon scene looks cut; both event paths end on OkWin +99 = row 100). Speakers inferred. 75/77 repeat rows 72/73 (hero to Pigmon); 76 repeats row 74: a hero realising Pigmon is now understandable thanks to Hikari's Pan-Space Interpreter. Identical Japanese kept identical.

Pigmon speaking through the Pan-Space Interpreter (katakana in the source, rows 78/85-87): rendered as stilted English with no contractions, distinct from its natural 'pi' speech. Same treatment suggested for DG_QUEST010 rows 24/71 (slice quest_010).
Rows 79-83: unreferenced five-row party variant block, identical Japanese; a hero answering Pigmon's thanks. Kept identical.

Unreferenced; speaker inferred as an Ultra (likely Ultraman: 'Captain Zoffy'). The source's particle slip (title 'ga' okuru) read as Zoffy awarding the title. 'Special Member' of the Hero Team is a coined rank title.
Narration, unreferenced.

Rows 95-98: no-Ultraman branch, Quest010.bla +94..+97 (mapping N+1): Alien Baltan 95/97, Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36) 96/98. Laugh kept as comma-separated 'Fo' per glossary note; identical Japanese in quest_010 row 33 should match.
Ankh, contemptuous -yagaru ('The bastard vanished'); Baltan g=m.
OkWin +99. Title from QuestMess 0.11. The following OkWin +100 points past the table (row 101 does not exist): script off-by-one, not a translation issue.

Quest 'The Prince of Sorrow' description row. QuestMess 0.62 says 'Black RX'; this row's source says 'RX', kept. Compressed to 2 lines ('please take RX and go investigate' -> 'Take RX and investigate'). Place 'Begins Cube' per glossary; 'West District' matches QuestMess.

Quest011.bla mapping verified as TextIdOffset+N = row N+1 (offset 0): +4 row 5 narration, +8 row 9 Pigmon, +10 row 11 Black RX, +15 row 16 Skullma, +20 row 21 Ankh, +75 OkWin row 76. Narration in present tense as in quest_001 ('You can hear...').
Pigmon's verbal tic (sentence-final 'pi') rendered as a trailing ', pi' / stretched 'piii'. First use in the quest corpus; quest_009/010 should follow the same convention.
Shown under a '???' name box (CHARA_NAME 30) before Skullma is identified; voiced as Skullma.

Kaima Youzoku (Crisis Empire's yokai clan) has no glossary entry; rendered 'Kaima Yokai Clan' (ChipLib translated the same word loosely as 'Kaima Beastman', which is the glossary term for a different corps, Kaima Juujin). Flag for glossary.
Skullma. Object (Pigmon) unstated; 'this one' keeps it gender-neutral (Pigmon g=n).
Unreferenced by Quest011.bla. 'RX' spelled out phonetically in katakana; speaker inferred as Pigmon (childlike), rendered 'Arr-Ex!'.
Script gives Skullma (CHARA_NAME 52, +22) for this line, so it is read as Skullma pressing RX, not an ally asking.
Skullma, mocking: 'hanashi ga wakaru' = RX is being reasonable.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36), +25.
Black RX's roar of grief/rage (+39).
Skullma; 'it/its' = Pigmon (villain's wording, Pigmon g=n).
Unreferenced; speaker inferred Black RX (lead-in to row 43).
Classic RX narration; English matches the story's rendering of the same line (MainEventMess0256 #0.91).

Skullma (+46). After this the script goes to battle 628; rows 48-55 (Skullmaster call-out, form changes, item/skill messages) are not referenced by Quest011.bla, so speakers are inferred: 48/50/54 Black RX, 51 the enemy.
'Skullmaster' per CharacterName/ChipLib (Skullma squad leader).
Source is missing the closing bracket after the second item; both names quoted in English. Item names 'Heart of Anger' / 'Heart of Sorrow' coined (not in item tables).

RX's Robo Rider roll call ('Prince of Sorrow'), Bio Rider in row 54 ('Prince of Anger'). Source writes BLACKRX without the space; glossary 'Black RX'. Form names follow ChipLib ('Robo Rider', 'Bio Rider').
Matches QuestMess 0.512 English.
Skullma's death cry (+57, CHARA_NAME 52).
'There's still breath' addressed to Pigmon, so 'You're still breathing'.
Pigmon (+70). OkWin +72 = row 73 (quest complete); the next OkWin +76 points to a nonexistent row 77 (likely meant the skill-unlock message): script off-by-one, not a translation issue.
Title from QuestMess 0.12.
OkWin +75, no-RX branch; same pattern as quest_007/008 party-requirement messages.

Quest 'Retrieving the O Raiser' description row. 'O Raiser', 'Maganac', 'Hideout Cube' per glossary/QuestMess 0.63. Compressed to the 2-line box: 'repairs finished, but stolen' -> 'the repaired O Raiser was stolen'; 'who is waiting at' -> 'at'.

Quest012.bla only references rows 68+ (the played version of this scene); rows 5-12 are an unreferenced earlier draft. Speakers inferred: Maganac 5/6/8/9/10/12 (polite); 7 and 11 a hero (calm, plain speech; possibly 00), voiced neutral.
'Betsudoutai' = a separate/other unit; 'transport Ride Machine' from the source, 'Ride Machine' as in QuestMess.
Subject 'we' restored (the heroes' side was attacked).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest010.bla (+94..+97 = rows 95-98, N+1), Quest011.bla (TextIdOffset+N = row N+1, verified on content and empty rows) and Quest012.bla (played scene starts at row 68). Unreferenced, speakers inferred: Quest010 75-89 (cut post-battle Pigmon scene), Quest011 17/42/48-55 (transformation sequence and item messages), Quest012 5-12 (earlier draft). Script OkWins past table end: Quest010 +100, Quest011 +76. Pigmon 'pi' tic and stilted interpreter speech set here (first use). Not in glossary: Kaima Yokai Clan (Kaima Youzoku), Heart of Anger / Heart of Sorrow (items, coined), Skullmaster (from CharacterName), Special Member (Hero Team title).
